name: Beneath Nordrassil
summary: Jediga sends you to tell Nara Wildmane about a burrow northeast of Valormok. She suspects it leads beneath the world tree and wants Nara to hear of it.

sections.title: Word for Nara
sections.body: Nara Wildmane is waiting at Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. Jediga sends you with news of a burrow northeast of her, where furbolg and satyr are fighting. She suspects the burrow runs beneath the world tree, and asks you to tell Nara what you saw.

faq.q: Who sent me to Nara Wildmane?
faq.answer: Jediga sent you to speak with Nara Wildmane.

faq.q: Where do I find Nara Wildmane?
faq.answer: Nara Wildmane is at Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Why does Jediga want Nara to hear about the burrow?
faq.answer: Jediga thinks the burrow may lead beneath the world tree and believes Nara may appreciate the information.

faq.q: Who is fighting over the burrow?
faq.answer: Furbolg and satyr are fighting over the burrow northeast of Jediga.
Jediga does not know what is inside; she suspects the burrow leads beneath the world tree.

angles.text: As a druid, you bring Nara Wildmane a report about a burrow that may lead beneath the world tree.
As a tauren, you carry Jediga's tip to Nara Wildmane, a tauren druid in Thunder Bluff.
